name: hanasaka-visitors
reviewNotes: All 42 original records reviewed; preserve released records 11-14 and their existing target exactly. Retaining the target does not verify expanded allocation capacity.

Records 30 and 32 intentionally contain sparse audible fragments and spaces. Preserve the broken speech without inventing a complete unheard sentence. Records 31 and 33 adapt historical-name wordplay and need editorial review before release.

Record 37 lists ichii-gashi, ubame-gashi and arakashi as shipbuilding timber; provisional botanical labels 赤皮櫟, 烏岡櫟 and 青剛櫟 require terminology review. The mermaid village clue points south from here and west of the starting village.
